description: All-in-one Salesforce sandbox toolkit. Seed data with AI personas, CSV import, or org cloning — with SFDMU export.json import. Sync orgs with conflict resolution. Compare metadata, monitor limits, and run pipelines you start by hand to back up, compare and check orgs — no pipeline step writes to your org.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: SandForge reads Salesforce credentials and writes records to your orgs, driven by configuration taken from the open folder. Trust the folder to enable it.

config.title: SandForge
config.telemetry.description: Record extension errors locally for diagnosis. Nothing is sent over the network.
config.orgs.validateOnStartup.descriptio: Validate registered orgs at startup and auto-refresh expired sessions via the sf CLI
config.seed.defaultBatchSize.description: Default batch size for Seed data operations
config.sync.defaultBatchSize.description: Default batch size for Sync data operations
config.ai.enabled.description: Enable AI Assistant (requires API key in secrets)
config.ai.provider.description: AI provider. Only `anthropic` is implemented, so it is the only choice. If settings.json names another provider, SandForge keeps AI off and sends nothing.
config.ai.model.description: AI model used by every SandForge AI feature: assistant chat, NL2SOQL, pipeline drafts, error resolution, Seed personas and Seed AI field rules.
config.ai.errorResolution.description: Send the error message of a failed Seed, Sync, DataOps or Automation run to the model for a fix suggestion, shown as a notification. Salesforce Ids are removed from the message first, and the messages SandForge writes itself are never sent. Off, the built-in table of common Salesforce error codes still answers on your machine while a SandForge view is open, and sends nothing.
config.ai.tokenBudgetMaxPerSession.descr: Maximum AI token budget for one window session, shared by every SandForge AI feature. SandForge warns at 80% and refuses further requests at 100%. The count runs until the window reloads or you run SandForge: Reset AI Token Budget. Changing this or any other sandforge.ai.* setting keeps it, and a new value applies to it at once.
config.backup.maxCount.description: Maximum number of backups to retain per org
config.safety.requireProdConfirmation.de: Require confirmation dialog for production org operations
config.safety.auditLogging.description: Record each Production Guard safety-check decision in an in-memory log (last 1000, this session only, never written to disk).
config.grappe.enabled.description: Run large seed, sync and autopilot operations in partitioned (grappe) mode. At or above sandforge.grappe.autoActivateThreshold records, seed reports each partition as it completes in the Grappe view, sync reports one partition per object, and autopilot reports only the start and the end of the run.
config.grappe.autoActivateThreshold.desc: Record count at or above which grappe mode activates (seed, sync and autopilot). Ignored when sandforge.grappe.enabled is off.
